description: Rules for an AI coding agent to filter out generic AI-generated UI designs, text, and code.

latest_release.name: v3.2.28: DeepSeek Harness joins as the eighth plugin door
latest_release.body:
**DeepSeek Harness becomes the eighth plugin door, and it needed no second package.** antislop already shipped as `antislop-ai`; that same package now declares a DSH bundle, so installing it by name from the Plugins page loads all six skills without copying a file.

## One package, two jobs

`antislop-ai` still installs skill folders into any of thirteen agents. It now also carries a `dsh.bundle.patch` and an `exports` entry for `./dsh`, which is what DeepSeek Harness reads when it treats the package as a plugin bundle.

The patch inserts one row, `antislop-ai/dsh`. That entry registers a skill provider, and the provider reads the six `SKILL.md` files straight out of the installed package.

The skills arrive at the bundled rank, so a folder install of the same skill still outranks it. A machine with both ends up with one copy in charge, the one the user put there.

## The installer covers it too

DeepSeek Harness joins the installer's agent list and reads the shared `.agents/skills` folder, the same one Antigravity, Copilot, Kimi Code, and Amp use. It is the fifth agent on that folder, so picking it beside any of them installs once.

The installer now covers thirteen agents over nine folders, and the guide lists the new door with its install, update, and remove steps.

## What is verified, and what is not

The repository check gained a case for the bundle: the patch path must exist, `dsh/` must be in `files`, and every patch row must name a subpath the package actually exports. The smoke test imports the plugin, registers a provider the way DeepSeek Harness does, and compares the six names against the skill folders.

The package was packed and installed into a fresh DSH profile on this machine. The profile composed with the `antislop-ai/dsh` row and raised no activation warning, and importing the installed plugin listed all six skills, each with its body and its own skill folder as the resource base.

Two things are not verified here: an install straight from the npm registry, and the skill list inside the desktop app. Both need a published package and a signed-in account, so they land with this release rather than before it.

## Updating

DeepSeek Harness lists an update when a newer `antislop-ai` reaches npm. If the button does not appear, remove the plugin and add it again, which fetches the newest release.

The installer route is unchanged:

```bash
npx antislop-ai --update
```

A plugin keeps its own copy, so update it through DeepSeek Harness. Skills load when a session starts, so start a new one afterwards. Full detail is in the ROADMAP.

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/antislop-ai?style=flat-square&color=cb3837&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/antislop-ai) [![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-20.12%2B-339933?style=flat-square&logo=nodedotjs&logoColor=white)](cli/package.json) [![skills.sh](https://skills.sh/b/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop?style=flat-square)](https://skills.sh/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop) [![MIT license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-f4c430?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-join-5865F2?style=flat-square&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/VWKggJfHFR) # Anti Slop: Rules for AI Coding Agents ### A rulebook that stops an AI coding agent shipping generic UI, text, and AI-shaped code. **A filter, not a style guide.** No prescribed colors, fonts, or layouts, and direction stays yours. **[Website](https://antislop.ai.id) · [Guide](GUIDE.md) · [Install](https://antislop.ai.id/install)** [Before and after](#before-and-after) · [Install](#install) · [What it does](#what-it-does) · [Skills](#skills) · [FAQ](#faq) npx antislop-ai
--- ## Before and after Each pair below is one brief, run twice, so the difference is visible side by side. ### UI With /antislop-ui. antislop alone is not the after. It removes the slop and stops there; direction comes from `DESIGN.md`. For UI work you intend to ship, that file is mandatory: without it the result is labelled a draft without direction. The pair below is the result. | **Before: without antislop** | **After: antislop + `DESIGN.md`** | |:--|:--| | | | | This is what most AI output looks like: slop everywhere once you take a closer look. | Much better. antislop kills the slop, and `DESIGN.md` gives it a real visual direction. | The two partial states are worth seeing, because each one shows why the other half matters: | **Partial: antislop alone** | **Partial: `DESIGN.md` alone** | |:--|:--| | | | | The slop is gone, but so is the direction. That is why antislop needs a `DESIGN.md`. | The direction is there, but honestly it is still far from good: the slop still shows. | ### Copywriting With /antislop-copywriting. One prompt, run twice. ### Accessibility With /antislop-human. One sign-in form, run twice. ### Mobile layout With /antislop-layoutmobile. One dashboard on a phone, run twice. ### Code With /antislop-code. One file, run twice. Every image here opens full size if you click it. ## Install antislop ships as standard agent skills: one folder per skill, holding a `SKILL.md`. Installation differs per agent, so pick the section for the one you use. Each route is walked through from zero, with update and removal, in [GUIDE.md](GUIDE.md#install-update-and-remove). ### The installer (recommended) One command, then answer the prompts. It asks which skills you want, where to install them (this project or everywhere), and which agents you use, then copies the folders and writes the pointer that reloads antislop every session. ```bash npx antislop-ai ``` ### The skills directory antislop is listed on [skills.sh](https://skills.sh/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop), the open directory for agent skills. This copies the same folders as the installer and nothing else, so antislop reloads by description alone. ```bash npx skills add miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop ``` ### Claude Code - Plugin ```text /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop /plugin install antislop@anti-slop ``` ### Antigravity - Plugin ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop ``` ### Codex - Plugin ```bash codex plugin marketplace add miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop codex plugin add antislop@anti-slop ``` ### Cursor - Plugin ```bash agent plugin marketplace add https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop ``` Then open **Customize**, find **antislop**, and select **Install**. ### Kimi Code - Plugin ```text /plugins install https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop ``` ### DeepSeek Harness - Plugin Open **Plugins**, choose **Add plugin**, paste this package name, and select **Install**: ```text antislop-ai ``` That is the desktop route. From a terminal instead, name the profile you use: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add antislop-ai ``` ### Cline - Plugin ```bash cline plugin install https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop.git ``` This door covers the Cline CLI. For the VS Code or JetBrains extension, use the installer. ### Oh My Pi - Plugin ```bash omp plugin marketplace add miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop omp plugin install antislop@anti-slop ``` ### Pi - Package ```bash pi install git:github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop ``` ### The single file `antislop.md` on its own is a complete filter you can paste into any chat window, with no packaging and no folders. ```bash curl -o antislop.md https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop/main/antislop.md ``` ## What it does - **40 mandatory rules** (R-01 to R-40) in three tiers: Hard Gate, Purpose-Gate, and Quality Locks. - **A Liveliness Toolkit**: three dials (ENERGY / RHYTHM / MOTION) and a Design Read, so the result comes out alive rather than merely clean. - **A Delivery Gate**: a mandatory PASS/FAIL report in four blocks, run before anything ships. - **Six skills**, one per concern, so an agent loads only what a task needs. The core prevents slop but cannot invent direction. `DESIGN.md` (yours) supplies it, and a sterile result means the direction was missing, not that the filter failed (R-37). antislop never beautifies on its own. ## Skills | Skill | Covers | Pick it for | |-------|--------|-------------| | antislop | The core filter: rules, tiers, the Delivery Gate, liveliness | Everything. Always loaded | | antislop-ui | Layout, color, components, decoration, motion, structure, performance | UI and visual work | | antislop-copywriting | Headlines, CTAs, tone, fake stats, anti-AI writing, markdown hygiene | Copy and text | | antislop-human | Contrast, keyboard, focus, states, interaction affordances | Accessibility | | antislop-layoutmobile | Reflow across screen widths, breakpoints, grids, overflow, tap targets | Responsive work | | antislop-code | AI-slop comments: which to remove, which to keep | Comment cleanup | Install one, several, or the core alone. ## Usage modes antislop runs one of two ways, and by default the agent asks which at the start of every session. Both end with a report you can check; they differ in when the rules apply. - **During** guides the work while it is built, and the session closes with the Delivery Gate report. Use it when you are building something new. - **After** audits work that already exists: a numbered findings list, you approve which to fix, then a follow-up report. Use it to clean up output you already have. Saving a preference is opt-in. With no settings file, antislop keeps asking in every new session exactly as it does today. Save your preferred mode once to skip that question: ```bash npx antislop-ai --mode during ``` Use `after` instead for audits, `ask` to restore the question in every session, or `--mode` alone to view the setting. The file is shared, so one command covers every agent and every project: `~/.config/antislop/settings.json` on Linux and macOS, `%APPDATA%\antislop\settings.json` on Windows. A mode you ask for in the current chat always wins for that session and never changes what is saved. When a saved preference applies, the skill says so once: **"antislop active: during (global preference)."** Older installs still carry the unconditional question, so run the update below to pick this up. ## Update antislop does not update itself. If you installed through the installer, one command replaces what is already there, in this project and under your home directory, and prints the release it replaced: ```bash npx antislop-ai --update ``` A plugin keeps its own copy under the agent that installed it, so it updates through its own command, and the Pi package updates through Pi. Every route is listed in [GUIDE.md](GUIDE.md#install-update-and-remove). Skills load when a session starts, so start a new one afterwards. ## FAQ **Is antislop a style guide?** No, a filter. It rejects technique without purpose and requires liveliness. Direction is yours. **Which agents does it work with?** Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, OpenCode, Cursor, Cline, Amp, Gemini CLI, Hermes, GitHub Copilot, Kimi Code, DeepSeek Harness, Pi, and Oh My Pi. The installer covers thirteen of them and detects which ones you have, and the plugin doors install from this same repository. [GUIDE.md](GUIDE.md) lists the folder each agent reads. **What is a skill?** A folder that goes deeper into one concern, holding a `SKILL.md` with its rules. Skills reference the core rules by number and never duplicate them, so adding one does not change the core. ## Roadmap **v3.2.28** adds DeepSeek Harness as the eighth plugin door: - **One package, two jobs.** `antislop-ai` now also declares a DSH bundle, so Plugins, Add plugin, and `antislop-ai` loads all six skills without copying files. - **Bundled rank.** The skills load at the bundled rank, so a folder install of the same skill still wins when both exist. - **Installer target.** DeepSeek Harness joins the agent list and reads the shared `.agents/skills` folder. Every earlier release, and what comes next, is in [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md). ## Star History [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop&type=Date)](https://star-history.com/#miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop&Date) ## Contributors Thanks to everyone who helps make antislop better.

Found a new slop pattern, a rule that missed something, or a bug in the installer? Open an [issue](https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop/issues). What a pull request has to carry is in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), and behavior in issues and pull requests is covered by [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

“antislop is a filter, not magic.
It clears the slop from your UI, text, and code.
A beautiful UI is DESIGN.md's job, and yours.”

## Disclaimer Get antislop from [miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop](https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop), [antislop.ai.id](https://antislop.ai.id), or the [antislop-ai npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/antislop-ai). The npm name `antislop` belongs to a different package, so `npx antislop` does not install this project. There is no antislop coin, token, or fundraising. Any crypto coin, token, NFT, or fundraising that uses the antislop name was not created by this project and is a scam. antislop accepts donations only through the Sponsor button on this repository and [Saweria](https://saweria.co/antislop); anyone collecting money in its name anywhere else is not authorized. ## License MIT: [LICENSE](LICENSE)
